title: Wii Sports Aww
blurb: Possibly the kindest failure sound ever programmed. When you gutter a bowling ball or miss the target entirely, the Wii Sports crowd does not boo — it makes a small, sympathetic aww, as though a group of strangers genuinely wanted this for you. That gentleness is the whole Wii-era design philosophy in miniature: the console was built for people who had never held a controller, so nothing in it was allowed to feel like punishment. Play it for near misses, honest attempts, and moments that deserve sympathy rather than mockery.
origin: The crowd's disappointed 'aww' from Wii Sports.
